stories.title: 1. Runde in der Europa League – Besiktas schlägt Marseille – gelungenes Debüt für Bournemouth

en.title: Europa League Round 1 – Besiktas beats Marseille – successful debut for Bournemouth
en.summary: Besiktas Istanbul won 4-1 against Olympique Marseille in their Europa League opening match.

stories.title: La défense du tortionnaire présumé de Moudon décrit un homme "immature", mais pas sadique

en.title: Defense of alleged Moudon torturer describes man as "immature", but not sadistic
en.summary: The defense lawyer for an alleged torturer in Moudon argued his client was immature during a trial in Renens, requesting 12 years imprisonment and free psychotherapy upon release.

stories.title: Le diesel frôle son record et met les transporteurs sous pression

en.title: Diesel nears record high and puts transporters under pressure
en.summary: Diesel prices exceeded 2.40 francs per liter at many stations in western Switzerland and approached 2.47 francs in Geneva, raising cost concerns for transport companies.

stories.title: Krieg im Nahen Osten – Medien: USA erteilen Iranern Visa für UNO-Sitzung

en.title: Middle East War – Media: USA grants Iranians visas for UN meeting
en.summary: The United States reportedly issued visas to Iranian officials including President Peseshkian and Foreign Minister Araghchi to attend a UN session in New York.

stories.title: Kylian Mbappé refuse d'afficher son soutien aux habitants de Ceuta et déclenche une polémique

en.title: Kylian Mbappé refuses to display support for Ceuta residents and triggers controversy
en.summary: Kylian Mbappé declined to fully wear a t-shirt in support of Ceuta's population, citing concern for suffering migrants. Spanish and French right-wing politicians have criticized the Real Madrid star over the incident.

stories.title: Handball: Champions League – Kriens-Luzern bleibt gegen Magdeburg chancenlos

en.title: Handball: Champions League – Kriens-Lucerne remains without chances against Magdeburg
en.summary: The Swiss champion suffered their second consecutive Champions League loss, finishing 29:39 against Magdeburg.

stories.title: Nicole Gnesotto: l'accord entre le Canada et l'Europe "est la refondation d'un nouvel Occident"

en.title: Nicole Gnesotto: the agreement between Canada and Europe "is the founding of a new West"
en.summary: The European Union and Canada signed a joint declaration reaffirming their commitment to liberal Western values in response to United States protectionist policies. Historian Nicole Gnesotto discusses the strategic implications of this alliance.

stories.title: Au Grand Théâtre de Genève, la magie de Prospero emporte «La Tempête» de Frank Martin

en.title: At Geneva's Grand Theatre, the magic of Prospero carries Frank Martin's "The Tempest"
en.summary: The Grand Theatre of Geneva opened its new season with Frank Martin's only opera, featuring a strong vocal cast led by Stéphane Degout as Prospero. The production combines lyrical passages with more challenging musical moments.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Krieg in der Ukraine: Putin stellt Vermögenswerte von Nestlé unter vorläufige Verwaltung +++ Selenski kritisiert China

en.title: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: Putin places Nestlé assets under provisional administration +++ Zelenskyy criticizes China
en.summary: Russia continues its ongoing war against Ukraine. Key developments include Putin placing Nestlé's assets under provisional administration and Zelenskyy expressing criticism toward China.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Putin stellt Nestlé Russland unter Zwangsverwaltung

en.title: War in Ukraine – Putin places Nestlé Russia under forced administration
en.summary: The Swiss food company Nestlé has lost control over part of its business operations in Russia as a result of Putin's forced administration order.

stories.title: Une panne électrique bloque toujours le trafic CFF entre Renens et Morges

en.title: Electrical outage still blocking CFF traffic between Renens and Morges
en.summary: An electrical failure disrupted rail traffic on CFF lines between Lausanne-Geneva and Lausanne-Yverdon Thursday evening, preventing train circulation for several hours from Renens with disruptions expected until at least midnight.

stories.title: Le trafic ferroviaire peine à reprendre entre Genève et Lausanne suite à une panne électrique

en.title: Railway traffic struggling to resume between Geneva and Lausanne following electrical outage
en.summary: An electrical failure disrupted train service between Lausanne and Geneva Thursday evening, with a fire caused by a fallen power line also affecting highway traffic. Normal operations were not expected before midnight.

stories.title: Wie viel Kapital braucht die UBS? Während den Politikern die Zeit für eine Antwort ausgeht, nehmen sich die Banker alle Zeit der Welt

en.title: How much capital does UBS need? While politicians run out of time for an answer, bankers take their time
en.summary: Swiss lawmakers express skepticism about proposed compromises regarding UBS capital requirements, while the bank adopts a conciliatory stance at a banking conference in St. Gallen.

stories.title: Helene Budliger hat die Zollverhandlungen mit den USA geprägt – wie geht es nun weiter?

en.title: Helene Budliger shaped tariff negotiations with the USA – what happens next?
en.summary: The outgoing Seco director played a key role in Swiss tariff talks with the United States, earning praise from the Swiss business community for her efforts, though overall success remains uncertain.

stories.title: Soziale Netzwerke: Kinder sollten wieder Kinder sein, sagt die EU-Kommissions-Präsidentin Ursula von der Leyen

en.title: Social networks: Children should be children again, says EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen
en.summary: The EU Commission proposes age-differentiated strict rules for social media use by minors under 18, with a legislative approach that differs significantly from how the United States regulates platforms.

stories.title: INTERAKTIV - Unsere interaktive Karte zeigt, wo und wie Russland in Europa zündelt

en.title: INTERACTIVE - Our interactive map shows where and how Russia is stirring trouble in Europe
en.summary: Moscow is testing European defensive capabilities through provocations away from the Ukraine battlefield. The report examines whether these actions represent preparation for a major attack.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Kanada und die EU: Aus dem Flirt könnte rasch eine enttäuschte Liebe werden

en.title: COMMENTARY - Canada and the EU: A flirtation could quickly become disappointed love
en.summary: Trump's policies are pushing Canada toward closer ties with Europe, though analysts question whether this will develop into a genuine strong alliance.
